title: SJE Quote v0.1.0
description: A seller's quote, standalone or inside a traveler's `quotes`. This schema accepts every quote the reference implementations accept and refuses every quote they refuse, except for the rules listed in not-expressible-0.1.0.json (rules a JSON Schema cannot state, or could state only by enumerating every case). Validate, then apply those rules. Numbers are judged as IEEE-754 binary64 values, string lengths in Unicode code points, patterns as ECMA-262 regular expressions.

valid_until.description: Must be later than created_at (compared as instants). Not expressible here: see not-expressible-0.1.0.json, rule quote-validity-window.

lines.description: One price per quantity: no two lines share a qty. Not expressible here: see not-expressible-0.1.0.json, rule unique-price-line-qty.

sig.description: Seller's signature over the quote body (the quote without this member).

hash.description: "sha384:" followed by the lowercase hex of a SHA-384 digest.

calendarDate.description: Applies to a string: it begins with a real calendar date YYYY-MM-DD (month 01-12, a day that exists in that month, 29 February only in a leap year by the Gregorian rule, for every year 0000-9999).

datetime.description: A UTC instant written exactly YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS[.f]Z: fixed-width fields, 1 to 9 fractional digits, hour 00-23, minute and second 00-59 (no leap second), a real calendar date, and a literal Z (no numeric offset).

trimmed.description: Applies to a string: neither its first nor its last character is white space as ECMAScript's String.prototype.trim defines it (U+0009-U+000D, U+0020, U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000-U+200A, U+2028, U+2029, U+202F, U+205F, U+3000, U+FEFF). Such a string is refused, never silently trimmed. U+0085 is not in the set.

name.description: A trimmed string of 1 to 128 code points.

line.description: A trimmed string of 1 to 200 code points.

text.description: Free text of 1 to 2000 code points (leading and trailing white space allowed).

money.description: Non-negative integer count of the currency's minor unit (e.g. cents for USD). Exact; no IEEE-754.

priceDelta.description: Signed integer count of the currency's minor unit.

itar.description: Self-declared ITAR registration. Not a quality certificate.

signature.description: An ML-DSA-87 signature, verified against a signed key directory.

freeForm.description: A free-form JSON object. Its compact serialization may not exceed 8 KiB. Not expressible here: see not-expressible-0.1.0.json, rule blob-size.

noProtoMember.description: Applies to any JSON value: no object inside it, at any depth, has a member named __proto__.
noProtoMember.$comment: The rule reaches every member through patternProperties (the empty pattern matches every name) rather than additionalProperties, on purpose. A clean-up pass that deletes whatever a schema's properties do not list (ajv removeAdditional: "all") treats additionalProperties as an instruction to delete, and would empty every free-form object.
